faith_group.name: Imperial Orders
faith_group.title: Pontifex
faith_group.description: The Imperial Orders descend from the temple-colleges of Old Pravend, organised under the eye of the reigning Imperial line. Their pontifex is by tradition seated at the Imperial capital.

faith_group.name: Canonical See
faith_group.title: Primarch
faith_group.description: The Canonical See is the assembly of priests who hold benefices across Vlandia, recognising a single primarch by oath.

faith_group.name: Druidic Circles
faith_group.title: Arch-Druid
faith_group.description: The druids of the Battanian highlands keep no central seat. Their counsel is heard in the sacred lynns and oak-rings, never under one roof.

faith_group.name: Ulama of the Sun
faith_group.title: Imam
faith_group.description: The Ulama are the learned faithful of the Aserai oases, gathered around the great mosques and madrasas of the south.

faith_group.name: Sky-Shamans
faith_group.title: Khan-Shaman
faith_group.description: The shamans of the steppe answer first to clan and khan, second to the spirits beneath the open sky.

faith_group.name: Old Gods Eldercouncil
faith_group.title: Eldgothi
faith_group.description: The eldercouncil of the northern peoples gathers at the great oaks each year to renew the bonds of the Old Gods with the living.

faith_group.name: Hraef-Sworn
faith_group.title: Hrafnskáld
faith_group.description: The Nordvyg recognise no priesthood beyond their own chieftains, who lead the offering and the war-rite alike.
